text: Terrible experience... We waited in line for 20 minutes because they were not very fast, but that's understandable because they did not have enough employees working at this moment. We ordered a Lion caramel mcflurry and a small bag of fries. We Walked away When we got our food. Then on the way we found out that the fries were cold and also very old. It was gross and we thought it was bad but whatever. Then we saw that there was no caramel in the mcflurry so it was just basic plain ice Cream.. We went back and asked why there was No caramel. The Guy who worked there rolled his eyes and sighted. He made up a story that we Said we did'nt want caramel which was not true. He took the icecream back that he gave me 10 minutes ago and added the caramel, he gave it back to me and it was totally melted. It was like a soup... I asked for a New one because this wasn't a mcflurry and he told us that he did'nt have it antmore, they had run out of it. I asked my money back but he tried to sell me a strawberry mcflurry which I did not want. He reacted irritated and gave the money back without looking at me or saying something and he started helping another customer while he handed the money to me. I've never had such a bad experience at a mcdonalds so this has me shook.
author: Seva Tolmeijer

text: Ordered a coffee and fries. It was the worst of either of those items that I've ever had in my life. I asked for a latte/any sort of coffee with milk and the lady understood me, then gave me coffee without milk. And the most bitter horrible coffee at that. And don't even get me started on the fries. Completely tasteless, not a sceric of salt, and they were 100% stale they should have been thrown out, I wouldn't have been surprised if I found mould on them. My partner snuck a fry from my bag and immediately spat it out. I ate 4 and then just threw away the rest of them because I just couldn't bring myself to eat something so horrible no matter how hungry I was. I can't believe there wasn't even any salt on the fries! And the fact that they were obviously at least a week old means I'm not sure that they were safe to eat, definitely do not come here ever under any circumstances. Starvation is preferable.
author: Julia Conway

text:
I decided that it was finally time for a McDonald's meal and made sure to google the opening hours before leaving my home. It says open untill 00:00.
So, at 23:15 I ordered a Big Mac Menu, but was told that they don't sell those. I asked what they selling then and was shown 6-7 burgers laying in the window.
That's just poor service! I don't mind that you're closing at 23 or 20, if that's what you are advertising, but claiming to be open and then not allowing customer to freely choose from the menu isn't what the McDonald's brand is known for. What a shame.
author: Kim Skovhus Andersen

text: After an exhausting day, I went to eat at McDonald's inside the Alexander Platz U bahn station and ordered a Big Mac meal. For the first time ever in my live, I got a cold, old and disgusting meal from them. The chips were old and soggy and the burger was cold as well, meaning, I got an old lunch they kept in the back. Asked to change meal and the manage, who didn't speak English well, or didn't understand or pretended he didn't understand. So, I because I had a train to catch I had to eat that disgusting meal.
